data.desc: Flywire combines a global payments platform and vertical software to solve complex, high-friction financial workflows for businesses and organizations worldwide. Because complex payments and workflows require purpose-built infrastructure rather than a generic processor, Flywire provides multi-rail, regulated payment flows, deep integrations into clients' core systems of record, and in-region expertise. Serving education, healthcare, travel, and B2B, Flywire embeds into mission-critical workflows, from tuition payment plans and patient billing to global travel transactions and invoice-to-cash, managing the full cycle from invoicing through settlement and reconciliation. Flywire supports more than 5,300 clients across 240+ countries and territories and is headquartered in Boston, MA, USA, with global offices.
